title: Q1 / ENV-001 — Quantify when semantic recoding has net value
body:
## Gate
G0

## Goal
Complete exact finite-state sequential diagnostic. Compare no communication, sufficient fixed code, best static code, and adaptive oracle with all migration and inspection costs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Verify positive, neutral and negative regimes; enumerate code ties; report optimality and full grid; freeze selection rule before learning. G0-0 is preliminary only.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q2 / ENV-002 — Isolate consequence shifts from frequency shifts
body:
## Gate
G0

## Goal
Implement C/F/N branches in a stateful failure environment with atomic tool actions. Keep first-decision distribution and scoring fixed for C; change transition consequences only.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Unit tests for paired exogenous randomness, fixed initial marginals, no reset within jobs, and distinct failure injection points. Document endogenous trajectory shifts.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q3 / OBS-001 — Enforce information boundaries
body:
## Gate
G0/G1

## Goal
Separate sender observations, receiver public history and external evaluator. Freeze model weights during each job; updates only use completed jobs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Schema tests show no hidden fault labels, hidden-state bypass, shared-memory or gradient leakage. Equal inspection option across conditions.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q4 / LEARN-001 — Establish basic communication and recovery
body:
## Gate
G1

## Goal
Use 12 development seeds to establish basic skills before adaptation. Record all runs, failed attempts and tuning costs.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Target 95% safe success per basic fault in all 12 seeds. Fix architecture, budgets, trainable parameters and observed runtime; if gate fails do not start G2.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q5 / BASE-001+002 — Implement matched controls
body:
## Gate
G1/G2

## Goal
Implement FF, FA, AF, AA from identical parent checkpoints; add NC, FS, FC, IB, AR strong controls.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Check codec freeze including embeddings and state; match sampling, actor update count, initial checkpoints and exogenous seeds; separate equal-experience and equal-compute tracks.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q6 / EVAL-001 — Measure semantic change and causal use
body:
## Gate
G1/G2

## Goal
Separate surface renaming, partition change, intervention effects, utility, safety, retention and held-out transfer.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Same-cost cross-state swap, equivalent-state swap and joint renaming control; report coverage, per-seed outcomes and independent evaluator contract.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q7 / COST-001 — Account for complete lifecycle costs
body:
## Gate
G1/G2

## Goal
Separate simulated time from measured wall time, payload from framing, compute from synchronization, and tool execution from recovery.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Report real wire bytes, blocking update/sync costs, compute, hardware/version manifest and reproducible cost accounting. Do not double count or set unmeasured costs to zero.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q8 / PROTO-001 — Freeze the confirmatory protocol
body:
## Gate
G2 entry

## Goal
Choose regime by G0 information value only; set n from G1 variability; freeze hypotheses, margins, all seeds, held-out folds, code and environment hashes before looking at confirmation outcomes.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Publish a timestamped protocol; 30–100 independent seed blocks as specified by power rule; preregister failure/stop/multiplicity rules; no outcome-driven early stop.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.

title: Q9 / CONF-001 — Run confirmation and independent backend validation
body:
## Gate
G2/G3

## Goal
Run the locked comparison and publish all results; then distinguish independent fixed transfer G3a from real-tool online adaptation G3b. G4 is a separate future question.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Report estimates/intervals, hazard margin, negative results, held-out failures, and full reproducibility. Do not claim utility or latency improvements beyond measured evidence.

## Evidence
Record the commit, commands, configuration, logs, and negative results. See `history/audit-v0.4/ETAL_research_plan_v0_4.md`.
